Step 1 — Deploy a new SellingAgent

ERC-8004 identity
v1 · new agent only
We mint a fresh agentId NFT on Base Sepolia (IdentityRegistry 0x8004…BD9e) and transfer it to your SellingAgent EOA. The agentId is the on-chain handle every settlement attestation is keyed to.
Bring-your-own-agentId (link an existing 8004 record instead of minting a new one) is a v1.5 path.
On-chain Splitter recipients
0xD53f… (seller, paid immediately)87%
0x0A02… (facilitator + deployer fee)3%
0x66C2… (risk / claims-contestation buffer)10%
Splits are immutable per agent. The 3% facilitator slot is constant across reputation. The 10% buffer accrues in the risk-buffer EOA on-chain and is conceptually released back to the seller as the agent's settlement-attestation count grows (see schedule below).
Risk-buffer release schedule
AttestationsTierBuffer released to seller
0+T0 — new0%
1+T1 — first-call5%
3+T2 — active15%
10+T3 — reliable30%
30+T4 — established50%
100+T5 — trusted70%
300+T6 — proven85%
1000+T7 — veteran100%
Exponentially-spaced tiers, gentler drawdown than the v0 four-step ramp. Higher trust = more of the escrowed buffer is claimable. Buyer-facing price never changes.
